high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "The Greatest of All Time." The poster features two muscular men dressed in tactical gear, standing in front of a helicopter. Both men are wearing black vests with their names, "Gandhi" and "Vinayak," written on them. They appear to be in a military or action-oriented setting, as suggested by their attire and the presence of the helicopter. The background shows a cloudy sky with a helicopter flying overhead, adding to the dramatic and intense atmosphere of the scene.
